# Payments API Documentation

## Overview
Base URL: https://api.example.com/v1
All requests require JSON bodies. Responses are JSON.

### GET /v1/charges/1
Standard GET operation for charges resource #1.
Request body: { "amount": integer, "currency": string }

### POST /v1/charges/2
Standard POST operation for charges resource #2.
Request body: { "amount": integer, "currency": string }

## Authentication
All endpoints require a Bearer token in the Authorization header.
Tokens are obtained via POST /v1/auth/token with client_id and client_secret.
Tokens expire after 3600 seconds; refresh via POST /v1/auth/refresh.

## Error Codes
- 400 invalid_request: malformed body
- 401 unauthorized: missing or expired token
- 402 card_declined: issuer refused charge
- 429 rate_limited: too many requests

## Rate Limits
100 requests per minute per key. On 429, retry after the Retry-After header value.

## Versioning
API version pinned via the X-API-Version header. Breaking changes ship as new dates.
